definition: to throw something gently and lightly
description: In a busy indoor fish market under a high iron roof, a young woman with a ponytail, a white T-shirt, a black waterproof apron and yellow rubber boots tosses a whole silver salmon high into the air with one hand. The salmon flies up and across the market, and a man further back catches it. Behind her another fishmonger raises both hands. White boxes of fish and mussels on ice fill the front, a tabby cat sits on a stack of crates, and older shoppers in winter coats watch.

taps.phrase: to perch on a white box
